title: Where your admin hours go
goal: Spot the repeat admin tasks worth templating — so you write once and reuse in seconds.

blocks.title: The email you keep retyping
blocks.body:
It's the third "please submit the fee form by Friday" message this month, and you're typing it from scratch again.

Parent notices, reminder emails, meeting notes, permission forms — small tasks, but they quietly eat your evenings. Let's take some of that time back. About 4 minutes.

blocks.title: Write it once, reuse it forever
blocks.body:
Here's the shift: instead of writing the same message fresh each time, you write it once as a template with [blanks] — the bits that change.

"Dear parents of Class [class], please submit [item] by [date]. Kindly [action]."

Next time, you fill the blanks in seconds and send. AI is brilliant at drafting these templates for you — you paste the result into your email, WhatsApp, or a Google Doc and it's ready to reuse. You stay in charge of the wording; AI just saves you the retyping.
blocks.goDeeper: A good template isn't only for you. Shared with a colleague, one clean notice format saves the whole staffroom from reinventing the same message.

blocks.question: Which admin task gives you the biggest time-back from a template?

options.text: A one-off email to a single parent about a unique, sensitive situation
The weekly fee-and-forms reminder you send to every class, every term
Deciding which student should receive the class prize this year

blocks.explanation: The big wins are the messages you send again and again with only small changes — that's exactly what a fill-in-the-blanks template is for. One-off sensitive notes deserve your personal touch, and real judgement calls always stay with you.

blocks.question: How clear are you now on which admin tasks are worth templating?
